summary: Completed comprehensive testing of social notifications and repost features. All backend APIs and frontend UI components are working correctly. The duplicate Share2 icon has been successfully removed, repost functionality is real and persists, and the full social notification loop is operational.
passed_tests: Backend: Notifications API requires authentication (403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/notifications/social returns array of notifications
Backend: PUT /api/comments/repost/:id creates cross-user notification and persists (repostsCount: 1, reposted: true)
Backend: GET /api/comments/reposts/user/:userId returns reposts feed (Alice's ETH ETF topic found)
Backend: POST /api/notifications/social/read marks notifications as read
Backend: Self-actions do NOT notify (admin's unread count is 0 after reposting)
Frontend: Notification bell visible in Buzz header (data-testid=notif-bell)
Frontend: Notification panel opens when bell is clicked (data-testid=notif-panel)
Frontend: Feed tab is accessible in Buzz header
Frontend: Single repost icon present (data-testid=topic-repost-btn) - exactly ONE Repeat2 icon
Frontend: NO Share2 icons found - duplicate/dead icon successfully removed
Frontend: Follow Me tab present on profile page
Frontend: Follow Me tab content renders (data-testid=followme-tab)
Frontend: Reposted discussions displayed (1 item with data-testid=followme-item)
Frontend: ETH ETF topic appears in Follow Me feed after repost
